reception: The citation record is small, and its judged portion is concentrated: the Kandemir–Ramanujam–Choudhary line on locality optimization cites the paper's findings as supporting evidence — that analyses a distributed-memory compiler must perform pay off as optimizations on shared-memory machines — and Tseng's own later work carries the argument forward. The rest are scattered passing mentions, in HPF benchmark compilation and software-cache management among them. Modest as it is, the record fits the paper's character: a position piece whose measurements are cited as evidence rather than a system to be built on.
